name: KSH International Ltd
tagline: Fast-growing, debt-free magnet-winding-wire exporter with genuinely strong 5-year growth, but a short public track record (2025 IPO) and a valuation that already reflects the quality
business_overview: KSH International (est. 1979/1981) is India's leading manufacturer of bare and insulated rectangular and round magnet winding wires and transposed cables, serving OEMs across power/distribution transformers, railways, automotive, renewables, and industrial motor/generator applications from three plants near Mumbai and Pune.
fundamentals_table: 8.36x book value; current price near 52-week high (Rs 1,005 vs high Rs 1,060, low Rs 330)
fundamentals_narrative: The quality profile here is genuinely strong across every dimension the thesis screens for: ROCE (21.4%) and ROE (20.1%) are both excellent, the balance sheet is debt-free, and 5-year revenue and profit CAGRs (47.5% and 50.3% respectively) are exceptional. The caveats are that the company only listed in 2025, so this growth history predates public-market scrutiny and there's limited track record as a listed entity, and the stock trades at a rich 8.36x book value near its 52-week high -- the market has clearly already recognized the quality.
technical_read: Current price (~Rs 1,005) sits just below the 52-week high (Rs 1,060), having risen sharply from the 52-week low (Rs 330) -- a name that has already re-rated significantly since listing.
